items.text: Over 12 months, what proportion of eligible heart failure discharges from Hospital A reach the nurse-led clinic within 14 days, how faithfully is the titration and self-care protocol delivered, and what does each clinic episode cost?
items.population: Adults discharged from Hospital A with heart failure who meet clinic criteria
items.outcome: Reach within 14 days, fidelity and cost per episode

items.text: Is 90-day readmission or death lower after Hospital A discharges than after Hospitals B and C discharges, and what utility change is observed in clinic patients at three months?
items.population: Adults discharged with heart failure from Hospitals A, B and C
items.intervention: Discharge from Hospital A with clinic follow-up
items.comparator: Discharge from Hospitals B and C with usual follow-up
items.outcome: Readmission or death within 90 days; utility at baseline and three months in clinic patients

finer: Feasible within 0.3 FTE and five minutes per visit if linked data arrive; interesting to the finance committee; novel for the region; ethical with consent for questionnaires; relevant to a March 2027 decision.
summary: An implementation question and a concurrent effectiveness question.
